about: A loop's in names one readable thing; it is never an expression (chapter 4 § 4.2.2). The for sections outlines each section of the input sections. Invalid: its in is { "var": "input.sections.value" }. Valid: the reference input.sections.value.
sentences: Loop 'sections' in is an expression; it names one readable thing: compute the value in a computed node and name that.
